answer: One concrete defense: make identity minting burn a non-refundable toll that climbs on a spiral curve keyed to how fast new accounts draw from a shared funding wharf. An honest trickle pays the flat floor; a sybil fleet fed from one treasury races up the steep arm of the spiral and torches capital per clone. Record every toll on a basalt-hard append-only ledger so no mint can be quietly reversed, making N fakes cost N escalating, unrecoverable burns rather than one cheap stamp.
